profile.headline: Experienced Full-stack Developer
profile.summary:
Frontend Development (UI/UX): Flexible and highly successful front-end application developer with proven track record of over 10+ years working with cross-functional teams including designers, QA, and DevOps to continuously ship new features and improvements to production. Extensive experience building, deploying, testing and monitoring user-facing and internal web applications. Diverse background of technological skills enabling efficient onboarding to complex projects, maintaining and upgrading codebases with high uptime.  Strong communication skills to interface / collaborate with business executives, vendors, cross-functional teams, users, and customers to complete software development projects successfully.

Full Stack Software Development: Proven background of 10+ years developing full stack software in IT industry with diverse background in DevOps, QA, Backend and Frontend. Led several projects through Software Development Lifecycle (inception, roadmap, solution architecture, development and deployment) as well as supporting products in customer environments. Exceptional expertise developing "greenfield products" in Typescript, ReactJS, and NodeJS through deployment and maintenance.  Maintained and improved existing products using Java or C#. Recognized multiple times by executives and stakeholders for project successes improving performance, user experience, and engagement.

Backend Development and DevOps: Proven record building and deploying highly scalable APIs in enterprise systems including General Dynamics IT, Blue-Cross Blue-Shield, and others. Focus on high uptime for customer facing applications particularly with database schema migrations and optimizing CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) pipelines for rapid feedback. Configured and deployed applications to cloud-infrastructure including AWS and self-provisioned VPS's. Exceptional expertise in Java and C# backends with extensive experience in NodeJS. Recognized multiple times for improving software quality, performance and deployments.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
NodeJS, ReactJS, Typescript/Javascript, TailwindCSS, Remix, NextJS, C#, PHP, AngularJS, MySQL, MS SQL Server, Postgres, Docker, Redis, Java, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, REST, HTTP, IPFS

Major Projects:

Online Media Platform Software Consultant: Collaborated closely with stakeholders to maintain and modernize existing media publishing sites with evolving needs, transitioning them into Single Page Applications (SPA) to enhance performance and user experience. Utilized AngularJS, C#, PHP, MySQL, SQLServer and to create REST APIs to transform traditional websites to dynamic and responsive SPAs.

Distributed Content Management System Consultant: Researched several technical solutions and developed a minimal viable product using cutting edge distributed technologies including IPFS, libp2p, CRDT's (conflict-free data types) written in JavaScript and AngularJS. Successfully developed a distributed content management system allowing user-friendly way for community leaders to create webpages to engage with a community of like-minded individuals.

Decentralized Crowdfunding Platform Development: Working with a small team of developers, designed and implemented a solution using Typescript, ReactJS, IPFS, Docker, to create a tamper-proof platform to create crowdfunding web applications with single form submission. Recognized for designing and implementing a user friendly, censorship resistant crowdfunding solution that went on to raise nearly $100,000 in funding.

Social Media Platform Development: Designed and implemented a social media platform that incorporated micropayments and smart contracts, deployed to cloud infrastructure using Typescript, NodeJS, Java, Kafka, Apache Flink, Redis, ReactJS, Remix, NodeJS, MySQL, Docker and AWS. Successfully created a small social media application with hundreds of users, frequent deployments and upgrades.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · React.js · TypeScript · Java · C# · PHP

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
C#, ASP.NET, .NET MVC, AngularJS, HTML, CSS, Razor, Swift, MS SQL Server, Apache Solr, Apache Lucene, JQuery, Google Analytics, Salesforce

Led multiple full-stack projects for Foundation of Economic Education's news publication platform written in C# ASP .NET MVC backend, AngularJS frontend, with MSSQLServer Database, serving thousands of daily visitors, editors, and writers. Led the initiative to optimize search experience with Solr and Lucene, A/B testing to measure user engagement, integration with Google Analytics, performance monitoring and sampling with software instrumentation, and push notifications for new articles.

Recognized for increasing donations, seminar and newsletter sign ups over 200& through the improved user search experience and application performance.  

Major Projects:

FEE Community Forum: Designed, developed, and shipped a comprehensive community forum solution using C#, AngularJS, and SQL Server. Worked with a cross-functional team to increase engagement using a Badge Rewards system for gamification. Successfully shipped a Community Forum allowing for the community to engage with each other and editors with comments and questions.

FEE Lessons Mobile Application: Worked with a small team of offshore contractors to develop an iOS prototype using the Swift language which was released on TestFlight. Released a Minimal Viable Product on iOS TestFlight integrated with our backend API and enabling push notifications via APNS.

positions.title: Software Developer II
positions.description:
C#, Java, EmberJS, Apache Solr, Selenium, ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, Razor, Spring Framework, Entity Framework, SOAP/WSDL, NUnit, JUnit, JMeter, Git, SVN.

Provided technical expertise for clients, developing web applications and testing solutions for a range of projects and programs to enhance performance and productivity. Worked with clients and cross-functional teams, ensuring accurate articulation of objectives and efficiency in business requirements gathering. Formulated project proposals and timelines to ensure delivery of quality above and beyond expectations.

Major Projects:

Blue Cross-Blue Shield: Worked with a cross-functional team to implement, test, review, and deploy a Healthcare search application developed in EmberJS, Java, Solr, and tested in Selenium. Built ahead of schedule and contract was extended to develop additional software for Cambia Health Solutions.

Software Trainer: Assisted in the training of over 60+ software engineers. Led training sessions on Java, C#, Spring Framework, Entity Framework, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Assisted with trainee assessment, testing, grading, and mentoring. Created and led lesson plans and projects. 30+ graduates went on to work for well-known companies including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Nike, and various government contracts.

General Dynamics IT: Worked with a large cross-functional team of Java Developers to develop Selenium test suites to find and fix issues and prevent regressions. Led an initiative to improve the performance of the test suite we developed using Selenium Grid. Recognized and promoted for improving the performance of our test suite by several orders of magnitude using Selenium grid.

Baltimore Sinai Hospital Network: Worked with a team of C# developers to Extract, Transform, and Load documents for The Sinai Hospital network applicant tracking system.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Java · C# · Ember.js · SQL · Spring Framework

positions.title: Desktop Administrator
positions.description: Delivered exemplary levels of support, maintaining desktop systems, upgrades and configurations. Worked collaboratively with system administration and engineering to optimize, network, servers and telecommunication systems stability and performance. Supervised and managed Junior Desktop Administrators maximizing performance through delivery of training.

positions.title: MES-Remote Resolutions-NT/Unix Technician
positions.description: Efficiently managed internal and external IT Service request for Unix and NT servers supporting 1000+end users across multiple organizations, along with associated devices and software such as Government issued Blackberry phones, MS Exchange Servers, Active Directory and VPNs (CISCO VPN).
